summary_md: **Yuval Kansal ([@yuvalkansal](https://x.com/yuvalkansal/status/2115619306453020803))** introduces **Self-Direction** (paper *"Don't Forget What You Just Learned: Self-Directed Repair…"*), exploring how lessons from each failure can be encoded as lightweight adapters so agents learn new skills quickly and recover more reliably — without RL. Paper and project website are linked.

referenced_urls.title: Don't Forget What You Just Learned: Self-Directed Repair Turns...

relevance: A cheap, non-RL path to agents that learn from their own mistakes.
